title: MicroSim Type Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners match five learning needs to the MicroSim type that serves them best: p5.js simulation, Chart.js chart, vis-network diagram, causal-loop diagram, or concept-classifier quiz.

learningObjectives: Identify different types of MicroSims (p5.js, Chart.js, vis-network, causal-loop, concept-classifier) and their appropriate use cases.

keyQuestions: Identify different types of MicroSims (p5.js, Chart.js, vis-network, causal-loop, concept-classifier) and their appropriate use cases.
commonMisconceptions: Any MicroSim type works for any concept.
assessmentOpportunities: Correct type for all five scenarios.
Learner can explain the difference between a network diagram and a causal-loop diagram.
